Definition: to fell a tree; generally, to destroy anything
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cut, hew, chop, cut down, hew down, hew off, cut off, cut in two, shave off; 1a) (Qal) to hew, chop in two; 1b) (Niphal) to be chopped off, be hewn off; 1c) (Piel) to cut off or down in two, hew off or down in two; 1d) (Pual) to chop down, hew down
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
